_doc: Eval suites of the KDD28 accuracy tables: datasets, fold ids, fold-file sha256, label rule, seeds, metric code, validation, early stopping. evalsuite.py checks rows and run plans against them and only warns ('WARN eval-suite:'). REPLICABILITY.md section K.

ydf_eval_v1.test_auc: YDF C++ metric evaluation (no sklearn): one-vs-other ROC of the last label-dictionary class on p = predicted distribution count(class) / sum, trapezoid over distinct thresholds (tied scores form one step, i.e. count 1/2), unweighted, every test row (prediction_sampling 1). yggdrasil_decision_forests/metric/metric.cc:1342 BuildROCCurve, :68 computeAUC
ydf_eval_v1.test_acc: metric::Accuracy (argmax class) of the same evaluation
ydf_eval_v1.train_oblique_forest: examples/train_oblique_forest.cc:1777-1809: EvaluateWithStatus on --test_csv, test_auc = rocs(rocs_size-1).auc(), logged on the 'test-accuracy:' line
ydf_eval_v1.train_distributed_gbt: examples/train_distributed_gbt.cc:338-347: Evaluate + TextReport. The driver takes the last '    auc:' line (metric/report.cc:488), i.e. the same last ROC
ydf_eval_v1.label_dictionary: count-descending: train_oblique_forest.cc:1010 (ties value-ascending), YDF CreateDataSpec dataset/data_spec_inference.cc:345 (ties string-descending)

kdd28_spo_advantage._note: SPO-advantage datasets for sec:accuracy-where-spo-outperforms-aa (user request 2026-11-06): datasets of kdd28_tabarena33 + kdd28_wide_datasets where single-machine SPO-GBT beats AA-GBT by > 0.005 test AUC (fold means), selected by benchmarks/results/kdd28/floats/accuracy/tab-accuracy-where-spo-outperforms-aa/select_spo_advantage.py. Rows keep their member suite's stamp.
kdd28_spo_advantage.headline: test_auc

kdd28_wide_datasets._note: Wide dataset eval (user directive 2026-11-04): F >= 100 features. Same protocol as kdd28_tabarena33 (SPAA paper eval) so its tables are comparable.
kdd28_wide_datasets.folds_rule: run_suite.make_folds: 5 CV folds, seed 0. Epsilon: its shipped train/test split as one holdout fold (k=0)
kdd28_wide_datasets.positive_class: AUC positive class = the last label-dictionary class = the least frequent training-fold class (label 1 for 0/1 labels from encode_binary_label, majority class = 0)
kdd28_wide_datasets.seed_protocol: seeds 1-5 per fold (kdd28_ydf rows: seed 1 only; seeds 2-5 added 2026-11-06 for kdd28_hao)
kdd28_wide_datasets.headline: test_auc

kdd28_tabarena33._note: Reference suite (user decision 2026-11-04): every comparable KDD28 accuracy table shares it.
kdd28_tabarena33.folds_rule: run_suite.make_folds: 5 CV folds, seed 0. Chronological 80/20 holdout (fold 0 only) for ecom-offers, homecredit-default, homesite-insurance (spaa27_experiments/REPLICABILITY.md section 4)
kdd28_tabarena33.positive_class: AUC positive class = the last label-dictionary class = the least frequent training-fold class (label 1 for 0/1 labels from encode_binary_label, majority class = 0)
kdd28_tabarena33.seed_protocol: seeds 1-5 per fold (kdd28_ydf rows: seed 1, plus seeds 2-5 of the distacc arms added 2026-11-20 (runs/2026-11-20_ydf_seeds); seeds 2-5 added 2026-11-06 for kdd28_hao)
kdd28_tabarena33.headline: test_auc

kdd28_cc18_fold0._note: 34 CC18 binary tasks, fold 0 only, prep_cc18_fold0.py. Not comparable with the reference suite.
kdd28_cc18_fold0.label_rule: encode_binary_label: two classes, majority train class = 0
kdd28_cc18_fold0.positive_class: AUC positive class = the last label-dictionary class = the least frequent training-fold class (label 1 for 0/1 labels from encode_binary_label, majority class = 0)
kdd28_cc18_fold0.headline: test_acc

kdd28_cc18_10fold._note: 34 CC18 binary tasks, 10 OpenML folds, run_cc18_aa_spo_gbt.sh data/. Raw string labels, per-dataset label column. Not comparable with the reference suite, and its fold 0 files differ from kdd28_cc18_fold0 (label name everywhere, cell values in 5 datasets).
kdd28_cc18_10fold.label_rule: raw class strings, label column from <dataset>/meta.json
kdd28_cc18_10fold.positive_class: AUC positive class = the last label-dictionary class = the least frequent training-fold class
kdd28_cc18_10fold.seed_protocol: seed 1 per fold (tab:cc18-aa-spo); seeds 1-5 per fold for the kdd28_ydf and kdd28_hao cc18 arms (2026-11-20, runs/2026-11-20_cc18_seeds)
kdd28_cc18_10fold.headline: test_acc

kdd28_tabarena_multiclass._note: TabArena multiclass tasks as majority class vs. rest (user request 2026-11-20). Same protocol as kdd28_tabarena33.
kdd28_tabarena_multiclass.seed_protocol: seeds 1-5 per fold, kdd28_ydf and kdd28_hao (2026-11-20)
kdd28_tabarena_multiclass.label_rule: benchmarks/data/tabular_suite_prep.py encode_binary_label: >2 classes -> 1 iff the majority class (ties: smaller value as string)
kdd28_tabarena_multiclass.positive_class: AUC positive class = the last label-dictionary class = the least frequent training-fold class
kdd28_tabarena_multiclass.headline: test_auc

kdd28_regression._note: TabArena + TabReD regression tasks (user request 2026-11-20), harness --task regression, test RMSE. TabReD = HF harbor train_full.csv, chronological 80/20 holdout.
kdd28_regression.seed_protocol: seeds 1-5 per fold, kdd28_ydf and kdd28_hao (2026-11-20)
kdd28_regression.folds_rule: run_suite.make_folds(regression=True): TabArena 5 KFold CV folds, seed 0. TabReD: chronological holdout, first 80 % train
kdd28_regression.label_rule: float label as in the source, never transformed
kdd28_regression.headline: test_rmse
